reviewed_findings.defect: noisy (0.42): The fine dark bands running in concentric spirals are authored turbulent accretion texture. The silhouette stays sharp and no incidental grain pattern overwhelms the outer disk.
reviewed_findings.defect: set_unfinished (0.48): The optical model is an intentionally stylized lensing illustration, with an unbroken physical disk, a complete spherical shadow and rendered deep field. The far alternate camera deliberately shows a large expanse of space.

notes.probe: The dark core is legible against the thin photon ring and warm disc. The outer emission tapers to black against sparse stars, while the upper arcs read as a stylized lensing illustration. The quarter-cycle camera tilt and disc texture animation are subtle.
notes.timeline: The central shadow stays sharp while the bright inner edge moves around the accretion disk and the camera subtly tilts. Orange spiral filaments fade outward without a hard colored rim. The thin upper arcs sit separately against black, with independent background-star movement from camera parallax.
notes.angles: The closer wide proof retains the three-dimensional relationship between the illustrated arcs and disk. The three-quarter proof shows that the distant stars are an intentional deep field. In the overhead proof the full annulus and its pink arc-shaped camera path are visible.
notes.seam: The four bordering frames show continuous orange texture swirl and a steady central ring silhouette. The normalized first-versus-extra frame difference is zero for the metric used by the studio.
